output.reason_for_conversation: understanding treatment options and preparation for shared decision-making
output.summary: User with 3-year RA history on methotrexate and sulfasalazine, with persistent active disease (synovitis, CRP 18-20, >1 hour morning stiffness), seeks to understand biologic options before rheumatologist appointment. Bot provided systematic overview of main biologic classes, discussed patient-specific factors (recurrent infections, prior shingles history raising JAK inhibitor caution, frequent travel), addressed cancer risk anxiety honestly, clarified Shingrix eligibility and timing, and co-created a focused question list for the appointment. User ended reassured and confident in approaching the conversation as a shared decision.
